title: Knowledge refs are resolved against the working tree, not HEAD
goal: KbAtHead reads kb files at HEAD (git cat-file), so on a dirty tree check neither reports stale knowledge for a fact HEAD still holds nor accepts a ref to an uncommitted article; a test plants each

run:
import pathlib, subprocess, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bl_check
d = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
r = d / 'kb' / 'public'
r.mkdir(parents=True)
(r / '_root.md').write_text('---\nroot: public\nid_prefix: S\nvisibility: public\n---\n\n# public\n', encoding='utf-8')
(r / '_sources.csv').write_text('id,url,title\nS1,https://example.com/a,A\n', encoding='utf-8')
g = ['git', '-C', str(d), '-c', 'user.name=t', '-c', 'user.email=t@example.com']
subprocess.run(g + ['init', '-q'], check=True)
subprocess.run(g + ['add', '-A'], check=True)
subprocess.run(g + ['commit', '-q', '-m', 'base'], check=True)
with open(r / '_sources.csv', 'a', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write('S2,https://example.com/b,B\n')
ids = bl_check.KbAtHead(d).source_ids()
sys.exit(0 if 'S1' in ids and 'S2' not in ids else 1)
